Flamenco runs in the family: Malú is the daughter of singer Pepe de Lucía and the niece of the legendary guitarist Paco de Lucía.

the-blue-stompers-jump-review.fact: Stylianou nævner blues-mundharpekoryfæerne Little Walter, James Harman, James Cotton og Kim Wilson som nogle af sine største inspirationskilder.

Vanesa Martín is a malagueña — born in Málaga in 1980 — so her Costa del Sol dates are a genuine hometown homecoming.
